title: Bangkok
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Bangkok, red Player card. Coordinates 13°45'23"N 100°30'6"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. The map has a target marker and no scratch-off box. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-06b.

rules: Port city: the compass is marked with an anchor.
No search box. Nothing on this card is scratched.
A dashed improvement slot is printed across the map.
notes: Printed code P3-06b is on side B only.
Goes to the reserve when Package 3 is opened. Jakarta is the only city this report places immediately.
